reasons: Only part of the file was covered in this packet, so these notes are incomplete.

terms.meaning: A named value, such as a color, defined once and reused across many style rules.
The part of a style rule that says which page elements it applies to.
A style rule that applies only at certain screen widths.
A line that loads another style sheet into this one.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Map library style import
sections.what: Loads the style sheet of the map library so map elements look correct.
sections.why: Needed so the map controls and map elements display properly.
sections.watch_out: The map styles must load before the app's own map rules, or the map may look wrong.

sections.name: :root
sections.title: Shared color and font variables
sections.what: Defines the named colors for surfaces, text, lines, and verification states, plus font settings. Other rules reuse these names.
sections.why: Keeps the design consistent and makes a color change easy to apply everywhere.
sections.watch_out: A comment says the green verification color must be kept exactly as it is, so changing it changes how verified results look.

sections.name: html
sections.title: Smooth scrolling for the page
sections.what: Makes page jumps, such as moving to a section, scroll smoothly instead of jumping.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code beyond a smoother reading experience.

sections.name: body
sections.title: Base page text and background
sections.what: Sets the warm background, dark text, sans-serif font, text size, line spacing, and left alignment for the whole page.
sections.why: Gives every page the same reading style.

sections.name: a
sections.title: Link style
sections.what: Makes links take the color of the text around them and removes the underline.
sections.why: Keeps links blending into the design.
sections.watch_out: Links look like plain text, so some users may not notice that they are clickable.

sections.name: button, input, textarea
sections.title: Form control font
sections.what: Makes buttons, text inputs, and text areas use the same font as the rest of the page.
sections.why: Stops form controls from showing a different default font.

sections.name: button
sections.title: Pointer style for buttons
sections.what: Shows a hand cursor when the mouse is over a button.
sections.why: Signals to the user that a button can be clicked.

sections.name: h1, h2, h3.display, .font-display
sections.title: Headings use display font
sections.what: Makes main headings and any element marked as display text use the heading typeface.
sections.why: Gives headings a distinct look apart from body text.
sections.watch_out: Changing the variable this uses changes every heading in the app.

sections.name: h1
sections.title: Main page title sizing
sections.what: Sets the size of the main page title so it grows with screen width, with tight line spacing.
sections.why: Keeps big titles readable on phones and desktops.

sections.name: h1 em
sections.title: Emphasised words in titles
sections.what: Shows words marked as emphasis inside a main title in the gold accent colour, without slanting them.
sections.why: Likely reason: highlights a key word while keeping the design calm.

sections.name: h2
sections.title: Section heading sizing
sections.what: Sets the size and spacing of second-level headings.
sections.why: Creates a clear step down from the page title.

sections.name: h3
sections.title: Small heading sizing
sections.what: Sets third-level headings to a medium size and semi-bold weight.
sections.why: Separates small titles inside cards and sections.

sections.name: p
sections.title: Paragraph basics
sections.what: Removes extra space above paragraphs and aligns their text to the left.
sections.why: Keeps text blocks tight and consistent.
sections.watch_out: Left alignment is forced here, so centred paragraphs need their own override.

sections.name: code, kbd, samp, pre, .hash-value, .font-mono, .hero-proof-facts dd, .traceability-list dd, .data-mono
sections.title: Monospace data text
sections.what: Shows code, identifiers, hashes and figures in a fixed-width font.
sections.why: Makes exact values easy to compare character by character.

sections.name: .eyebrow
sections.title: Small label above headings
sections.what: Styles the short green label that sits above a heading.
sections.why: Adds context without drawing too much attention.

sections.name: .lead
sections.title: Intro paragraph style
sections.what: Makes the opening paragraph under a title larger and muted, with a limited width.
sections.why: Makes the opening sentence stand out from body text.

sections.name: .micro
sections.title: Tiny helper text
sections.what: Shows small muted helper text, and lets long strings wrap instead of overflowing.
sections.why: Keeps fine print out of the way while long values stay visible.

sections.name: .skip
sections.title: Hidden skip link
sections.what: Moves the skip-to-content link off screen so it is hidden by default.
sections.why: Lets keyboard and screen reader users jump past the header.
sections.watch_out: The link is hidden by moving it far left, so it must work with the focus rule below.

sections.name: .skip:focus
sections.title: Skip link when focused
sections.what: Brings the skip link on screen with a dark box and gold border when a keyboard user reaches it.
sections.why: Shows the link only when someone needs it.

sections.name: .site-header
sections.title: Top bar layout
sections.what: Creates a fixed-height dark top bar with the brand on the left and navigation on the right.
sections.why: Keeps navigation consistent on every page.
sections.watch_out: The bar has a fixed 72px height on desktop; the phone rules override it.

sections.name: .brand
sections.title: Brand name styling
sections.what: Styles the brand name in the top bar with a large display font and light colour, next to a small logo mark.
sections.why: Gives the app a recognisable name in the header.

sections.name: .brand span span
sections.title: Gold part of brand name
sections.what: Colours a nested part of the brand name gold.
sections.why: Likely reason: highlights one word of the brand.

sections.name: .brand-mark
sections.title: Small logo square
sections.what: Draws a 28-pixel gold square with a dark letter, used as the logo mark.
sections.why: Gives the brand a simple visual symbol.

sections.name: .site-header nav
sections.title: Header navigation row
sections.what: Lays out the header links in a row with even spacing.
sections.why: Keeps links easy to scan.

sections.name: .site-header nav > a:not(.button)
sections.title: Header link look
sections.what: Shows header links that are not buttons in a light grey bold style.
sections.why: Keeps plain links visually lighter than the call-to-action button.

sections.name: .site-header nav > a:not(.button):hover
sections.title: Header link hover colour
sections.what: Turns a header link gold when the mouse is over it.
sections.why: Shows the link is clickable.

sections.name: .site-header .locale-switch
sections.title: Language switch button look
sections.what: Styles the header button used to change language as a dark outlined button.
sections.why: Lets users change language from the header.
sections.watch_out: Phone sizing for this button is set in locale.css as well.

sections.name: .site-header .locale-switch:hover
sections.title: Language button hover
sections.what: Turns the language button gold with a faint gold background on hover.
sections.why: Shows the button responds to the mouse.

sections.name: .site-header .locale-switch:focus-visible
sections.title: Language button keyboard focus
sections.what: Shows a gold outline when the language button is reached by keyboard.
sections.why: Lets keyboard users see where they are.

sections.name: .site-header .button
sections.title: Header call-to-action button
sections.what: Styles a gold filled button in the header.
sections.why: Makes the main header action stand out.

sections.name: .site-header .button:hover
sections.title: Header button hover
sections.what: Lightens the gold header button slightly when hovered.
sections.why: Shows the button responds to the mouse.

sections.name: .site-header .button:focus-visible
sections.title: Header button keyboard focus
sections.what: Shows a soft gold outline on the header button when reached by keyboard.
sections.why: Keeps keyboard focus visible.

sections.name: .notice
sections.title: Top notice strip
sections.what: Styles a thin strip of small centred text above the content in soft blue-grey.
sections.why: Likely reason: shows short announcements without pulling attention from the page.

sections.name: main
sections.title: Main content width and spacing
sections.what: Centres the main page content up to 1180 pixels wide with padding around it.
sections.why: Keeps line lengths readable on wide screens.

sections.name: main.landing-main
sections.title: Full-width landing content
sections.what: Removes the width limit and padding for the home page main area so sections can run edge to edge.
sections.why: Landing sections need full-width background colours.
sections.watch_out: Applies only to main elements with the landing-main class; other pages keep the standard width.

sections.name: footer
sections.title: Page footer
sections.what: Styles the footer as a centred dark band with small grey text.
sections.why: Closes each page in the same style as the header.

sections.name: .button
sections.title: Standard button look
sections.what: Styles the standard button as a green filled rounded button at least 46 pixels tall.
sections.why: Gives buttons a consistent size and colour.
sections.watch_out: Other button rules override parts of this, so check the most specific rule when a button looks wrong.

sections.name: .button:hover
sections.title: Standard button hover
sections.what: Darkens the standard green button on hover.
sections.why: Shows the button responds to the mouse.

sections.name: .button.secondary
sections.title: Outline button look
sections.what: Styles a secondary button as transparent with a green border and green text.
sections.why: Lets a secondary action look less strong than the main action.

sections.name: .button.secondary:hover
sections.title: Outline button hover
sections.what: Adds a faint green background to the outline button on hover.
sections.why: Shows the button responds to the mouse.

sections.name: .button.small
sections.title: Compact button size
sections.what: Makes a button shorter with smaller text.
sections.why: Fits buttons into tight spaces such as cards.

sections.name: button:focus-visible, a:focus-visible, textarea:focus-visible, input:focus-visible
sections.title: Keyboard focus outline
sections.what: Draws a light green outline on buttons, links, text areas and inputs when they have keyboard focus.
sections.why: Keeps keyboard focus visible, which matters for accessibility.
sections.watch_out: Removing this rule would hide focus for keyboard users.

sections.name: .actions
sections.title: Row of action buttons
sections.what: Lays out a group of action buttons in a wrapping row with space between them.
sections.why: Keeps buttons readable on narrow screens.

sections.name: .compact-action
sections.title: Text-style action link
sections.what: Styles a compact action as a bold green text link with a 44-pixel tap area.
sections.why: Gives a small action that is still easy to tap on phones.

sections.name: .compact-action:hover
sections.title: Text action hover
sections.what: Darkens the compact action link on hover.
sections.why: Shows the link responds to the mouse.

sections.name: .trust-surface
sections.title: Dark trust section background
sections.what: Sets a dark background and light text for the trust-focused opening section.
sections.why: Sets a serious tone for the opening of the page.

sections.name: .hero-surface-wrap
sections.title: Hero band
sections.what: Creates a full-width dark band with padding and a gold line along its bottom edge.
sections.why: Separates the hero from the content below.

sections.name: .hero-container
sections.title: Hero two-column layout
sections.what: Splits the hero into a wider text column and a narrower visual column.
sections.why: Puts the explanation beside the visual on desktop.
sections.watch_out: The layout switches to one column on phones in a separate rule.

sections.name: .hero-eyebrow
sections.title: Hero small label
sections.what: Styles the small gold monospace label above the hero title.
sections.why: Adds a quiet entry point above the title.

sections.name: .hero-copy-column h1
sections.title: Hero title
sections.what: Shows the hero title in white display font with space below.
sections.why: Makes the main message the first thing read.

sections.name: .hero-copy-column .lead
sections.title: Hero intro paragraph
sections.what: Shows the hero intro in a larger light blue-grey paragraph.
sections.why: Gives the opening explanation a readable size on dark background.

sections.name: .hero-copy-column .actions .button.secondary
sections.title: Hero outline button
sections.what: Styles the secondary hero button with a white outline and white text.
sections.why: Keeps the button visible on dark background.

sections.name: .hero-copy-column .actions .button.secondary:hover
sections.title: Hero outline button hover
sections.what: Adds a faint white background and brighter border to the hero outline button on hover.
sections.why: Shows the button responds to the mouse.

sections.name: .hero-copy-column .micro
sections.title: Hero small note
sections.what: Styles a small muted note under the hero actions.
sections.why: Adds fine print without competing with the title.

sections.name: .hero-visual-column
sections.title: Hero visual column
sections.what: Stacks the globe and the trust card in a centred column.
sections.why: Keeps the visual side tidy beside the text.

sections.name: .globe-wrapper
sections.title: Globe box size
sections.what: Sets a square box, up to 420 pixels wide, that holds the globe visual.
sections.why: Keeps the visual at a controlled size.
sections.watch_out: This sizes the box only; the globe drawing itself is set elsewhere.

sections.name: .hero-card.trust-card
sections.title: Hero trust card
sections.what: Styles the trust summary card as a dark translucent box with a gold border and shadow.
sections.why: Makes the summary feel separate from the page background.

sections.name: .hero-card.trust-card .eyebrow
sections.title: Trust card small label
sections.what: Styles the small gold monospace label inside the trust card.
sections.why: Matches the hero label style.

sections.name: .hero-steps
sections.title: Hero step list
sections.what: Removes bullets and spacing from the list of steps in the hero card.
sections.why: Lets the steps read as a clean list.

sections.name: .hero-steps li
sections.title: Single step row
sections.what: Styles each hero step with a divider above it and light text.
sections.why: Separates the steps visually.

sections.name: .hero-steps b
sections.title: Step number
sections.what: Styles the step number in gold monospace bold.
sections.why: Makes the order of steps easy to scan.

sections.name: .hero-proof-facts
sections.title: Proof facts grid
sections.what: Lays out the short proof facts in two columns.
sections.why: Shows several facts compactly.

sections.name: .hero-proof-facts div
sections.title: Proof fact cell
sections.what: Gives each proof fact a faint gold top line and padding.
sections.why: Separates each fact.

sections.name: .hero-proof-facts div:last-child
sections.title: Last proof fact spans width
sections.what: Makes the last proof fact span both columns.
sections.why: Keeps the grid balanced when the count is odd.

sections.name: .hero-proof-facts dt
sections.title: Proof fact label
sections.what: Styles the label of each proof fact in small faint text.
sections.why: Keeps the label secondary to the value.

sections.name: .hero-proof-facts dd
sections.title: Proof fact value
sections.what: Shows the value of each proof fact in white monospace text that can wrap at any point.
sections.why: Keeps exact values readable and lets long ones fit.
sections.watch_out: Long values can break in the middle of words.

sections.name: .hero-card-actions
sections.title: Trust card button row
sections.what: Lays out the card's actions in a spaced row that wraps.
sections.why: Keeps actions visible on narrow screens.

sections.name: .hero-card.trust-card .compact-action
sections.title: Trust card gold link
sections.what: Styles the link inside the trust card as semi-bold gold.
sections.why: Makes the link stand out on the dark card.

sections.name: .hero-card.trust-card .compact-action:hover
sections.title: Trust card link hover
sections.what: Lightens the trust card link on hover.
sections.why: Shows the link responds to the mouse.

sections.name: .section
sections.title: Standard content section
sections.what: Gives standard content sections 64 pixels of space above and below.
sections.why: Separates sections so each has room to breathe.

sections.name: .section-container
sections.title: Centred section width
sections.what: Centres section content up to 1180 pixels wide with side padding.
sections.why: Keeps sections aligned with the main content width.

sections.name: .product-proof
sections.title: Product proof section spacing
sections.what: Sets the padding for the product proof section to 68 pixels above and below.
sections.why: Gives the proof section its own spacing.
sections.watch_out: The standard section class also sets padding, and this later rule wins.

sections.name: .product-proof-grid
sections.title: Four proof cards grid
sections.what: Lays out the product proof cards in four equal columns.
sections.why: Shows the proof points side by side.

sections.name: .product-proof-card
sections.title: Proof card box
sections.what: Styles each product proof card as a bordered, rounded, padded box.
sections.why: Makes each proof point a distinct unit.

sections.name: .product-proof-card:hover
sections.title: Proof card hover lift
sections.what: Darkens the proof card border and lifts the card 2 pixels on hover.
sections.why: Shows the card is interactive.

sections.name: .product-proof-card h3
sections.title: Proof card title
sections.what: Styles the proof card title as bold green text.
sections.why: Makes each proof point easy to find.

sections.name: .product-proof-card p
sections.title: Proof card text
sections.what: Styles the proof card text as small muted text.
sections.why: Keeps the description secondary to the title.

sections.name: .narrative-surface
sections.title: Who it is for section
sections.what: Creates a warm off-white band with lines above and below for the 'who this is for' section.
sections.why: The code comment says this section sits on warm paper, which sets it apart.

sections.name: .narrative-container
sections.title: Narrow centred column
sections.what: Limits the narrative content to 820 pixels and centres it.
sections.why: Keeps long reading lines comfortable.

sections.name: .narrative-surface h2
sections.title: Narrative heading
sections.what: Styles the narrative heading in the display font, large and dark.
sections.why: Gives the section a clear title.

sections.name: .narrative-body
sections.title: Narrative lead text
sections.what: Shows the narrative lead paragraph in a large, relaxed style.
sections.why: Makes the opening paragraph easy to read.

sections.name: .narrative-columns
sections.title: Two narrative columns
sections.what: Lays out narrative blocks in two equal columns.
sections.why: Shows two related points side by side.

sections.name: .narrative-block
sections.title: Narrative card
sections.what: Styles each narrative block as a padded, bordered card.
sections.why: Separates each point visually.

sections.name: .narrative-block h3
sections.title: Narrative card heading
sections.what: Styles the heading in a narrative card in display font.
sections.why: Matches the section headings.

sections.name: .narrative-block p
sections.title: Narrative card text
sections.what: Styles the body text in a narrative card as small dark text.
sections.why: Keeps the card text compact and readable.

sections.name: .how-it-works-section
sections.title: How it works section
sections.what: Gives the how-it-works section padding and a pale grey-green background.
sections.why: Sets this working section apart from the others.

sections.name: .action-grid
sections.title: Three action cards grid
sections.what: Lays out the action cards in three equal columns.
sections.why: Shows the main actions side by side.

sections.name: .action-card
sections.title: Action card box
sections.what: Styles each action card as a bordered row with text on the left and space to the right for an icon or arrow.
sections.why: Makes each action look like a button that also explains itself.

sections.name: .action-card:hover, .action-card:focus-visible
sections.title: Action card highlight
sections.what: Shows a green border, soft shadow and lift when an action card is hovered or focused.
sections.why: Makes it clear the card can be chosen, including by keyboard.
sections.watch_out: Hover and keyboard focus share one look, so keyboard users see the same highlight.

sections.name: .action-card h3
sections.title: Action card title
sections.what: Styles the action card title in dark text with a small gap below.
sections.why: Makes the action name easy to read.

sections.name: .action-card p
sections.title: Action card description
sections.what: Styles the action card description as small muted text.
sections.why: Explains the action without competing with the title.

sections.name: .action-card.emphasis
sections.title: Highlighted action card
sections.what: Gives one action card a green border and pale green fill.
sections.why: Likely reason: marks the main next step for the user.

sections.name: .case-layout
sections.title: Case page two-column layout
sections.what: Splits a case page into a 200-pixel side menu and a main content area, up to 1320 pixels wide.
sections.why: Keeps navigation beside the content.
sections.watch_out: On phones this switches to a single column in a separate rule.

sections.name: .case-nav
sections.title: Case side menu
sections.what: Makes the case side menu a sticky column that stays visible while the page scrolls.
sections.why: Lets users jump between case sections from anywhere on the page.
sections.watch_out: The sticky position is switched off on phones.

sections.name: .case-nav a
sections.title: Case menu link
sections.what: Styles each case menu link with rounded corners and muted dark text.
sections.why: Makes the menu easy to scan.

sections.name: .case-nav a.active, .case-nav a:hover
sections.title: Current case menu item
sections.what: Shows the current or hovered case menu link with a pale green fill, green text and bolder weight.
sections.why: Shows where the user is.

sections.name: .case-nav-primary, .case-nav-context-links
sections.title: Case menu link groups
sections.what: Stacks the primary and context link groups in the case menu with small gaps.
sections.why: Keeps each group tidy.

sections.name: .case-nav-context
sections.title: Secondary case menu group
sections.what: Adds a divider and space above the secondary group in the case menu.
sections.why: Separates it from the primary links.

sections.name: .case-nav-context summary
sections.title: Collapsible menu heading
sections.what: Styles the clickable heading of a collapsible menu group with a 44-pixel tap area.
sections.why: Lets users open and close the group.
sections.watch_out: Likely reason: comes from a collapsible HTML section element, so the open and closed state is handled by the browser.

sections.name: .case-nav-context summary:focus-visible
sections.title: Collapsible heading focus
sections.what: Shows a light green outline on the collapsible heading when focused by keyboard.
sections.why: Keeps keyboard focus visible.

sections.name: .case-nav-context[open] summary
sections.title: Open collapsible heading colour
sections.what: Turns the heading green while its group is open.
sections.why: Shows which group is open.

sections.name: .case-nav-context-links
sections.title: Collapsible group links spacing
sections.what: Adds a little top space inside an open collapsible group.
sections.why: Separates its links from the heading.

sections.name: .case-content
sections.title: Case main content area
sections.what: Lets the main case content shrink and caps it at 900 pixels.
sections.why: Keeps reading width comfortable beside the side menu.

sections.name: .case-header
sections.title: Case title block spacing
sections.what: Adds space below the case title block.
sections.why: Separates the header from the content below.

sections.name: .case-header h1
sections.title: Case page title
sections.what: Sizes the case page title between 2 and 3 rem depending on screen width.
sections.why: Keeps the title prominent without overflowing on small screens.

sections.name: .case-header > p:last-child
sections.title: Case subtitle
sections.what: Shows the last paragraph of the case header in muted text.
sections.why: Keeps the subtitle secondary to the title.

sections.name: .progress
sections.title: Progress panel
sections.what: Styles the progress panel as a bordered box with padding and small text.
sections.why: Shows how far the case has moved along.

sections.name: .progress span
sections.title: Progress label
sections.what: Styles text inside the progress panel as muted.
sections.why: Keeps progress wording quiet.

sections.name: .track
sections.title: Progress bar track
sections.what: Draws a thin grey bar with rounded ends that hides anything beyond its edge.
sections.why: Gives the progress fill a container.

sections.name: .track i
sections.title: Progress bar fill
sections.what: Draws the green part of the progress bar, rounded to match the track.
sections.why: Shows the completed share.
sections.watch_out: The fill's width is not set here, so it comes from the page markup.

sections.name: .dashboard-grid
sections.title: Three summary cards grid
sections.what: Lays out summary cards in three equal columns.
sections.why: Shows several summaries side by side.

sections.name: .summary-card
sections.title: Summary card box
sections.what: Styles each summary card as a bordered, rounded, padded box.
sections.why: Groups each summary into one unit.

sections.name: .summary-card h2
sections.title: Summary card heading
sections.what: Sets the summary card heading to a smaller size with a small gap below.
sections.why: Keeps the card compact.

sections.name: .summary-card p:not(.eyebrow)
sections.title: Summary card text
sections.what: Styles summary card text as small muted text with a minimum height.
sections.why: Keeps cards the same height so they line up.

sections.name: .text-link
sections.title: Plain text link
sections.what: Styles a text link as bold green small text.
sections.why: Gives a light action link beside content.

sections.name: .text-link:hover
sections.title: Plain text link hover
sections.what: Darkens the plain text link on hover.
sections.why: Shows the link responds to the mouse.

sections.name: .section-head
sections.title: Heading with side action
sections.what: Lays out a section heading and its action side by side, wrapping when needed.
sections.why: Keeps the action near the heading.

sections.name: .section-head h2
sections.title: Section heading size
sections.what: Sets the section heading to a compact size with no margin.
sections.why: Fits it neatly beside an action.

sections.name: .document-list
sections.title: Bordered document list
sections.what: Shows a list of documents as one stacked box with a border and clipped corners.
sections.why: Makes a list look like one ledger.

sections.name: .document-workflow
sections.title: Document row
sections.what: Styles each document row as a grid with padding and a divider below.
sections.why: Separates each document clearly.

sections.name: .document-workflow:last-child
sections.title: Last document row
sections.what: Removes the bottom divider from the last document row.
sections.why: Avoids a double line at the list edge.

sections.name: .document-workflow:hover
sections.title: Document row hover
sections.what: Adds a very pale tint to a document row on hover.
sections.why: Shows the row responds to the mouse.

sections.name: .document-actions
sections.title: Right-aligned document actions
sections.what: Pushes document action buttons to the right.
sections.why: Keeps actions in a consistent place.

sections.name: .document-card
sections.title: Document entry layout
sections.what: Lays out a document entry as an icon and text in a row, without its own box or border.
sections.why: Lets the entry sit inside the list row.

sections.name: .document-icon
sections.title: Document icon box
sections.what: Shows a 40-pixel pale square with a green icon for each document.
sections.why: Gives each document a quick visual cue.

sections.name: .document-card > div:nth-child(2)
sections.title: Document text area
sections.what: Lets the text beside the document icon grow and shrink to fit.
sections.why: Keeps long names within the row.

sections.name: .document-card h3
sections.title: Document name
sections.what: Styles the document name as a small title that can wrap at any point.
sections.why: Keeps long file names readable.

sections.name: .document-card p
sections.title: Document detail text
sections.what: Styles the detail under a document name as small muted text.
sections.why: Keeps the detail secondary.

sections.name: .status
sections.title: Status text
sections.what: Makes status text bold.
sections.why: Makes status words stand out slightly.

sections.name: .status.ready
sections.title: Ready status colour
sections.what: Colours the ready status green.
sections.why: Shows at a glance that something is ready.

sections.name: @media (max-width: 760px)  (part 1)
sections.title: Phone layout for header and hero
sections.what: Below 760 pixels wide, stacks the header, shrinks the brand and navigation, makes the hero one column and shows the proof cards in two columns.
sections.why: Keeps the top of the page usable on phones.
sections.watch_out: The 760-pixel breakpoint must match the other phone rules in this file.

sections.name: @media (max-width: 760px)  (part 2)
sections.title: Phone layout for cards and cases
sections.what: Below 760 pixels, makes grids single-column, turns the case side menu into a flat list and reduces section padding.
sections.why: Keeps cards and case pages readable on phones.
sections.watch_out: The case menu rules use important flags, so future changes must also use them to override.

sections.name: @media (max-width: 760px)  (part 3)
sections.title: Phone layout for records and maps
sections.what: Below 760 pixels, stacks family, comparison, document, traceability, parcel and area panels in one column and shortens the map to 280 pixels.
sections.why: Keeps dense detail panels readable on phones.

sections.name: @media (max-width: 760px)  (part 4)
sections.title: Phone layout for comparisons and imports
sections.what: Below 760 pixels, stacks area comparison rows vertically, left-aligns their figures, stacks empty imported records and makes their button full width.
sections.why: Keeps comparison and import sections usable on phones.

summary: The global style file. It sets the colors, fonts, base layout, and many component styles used across the app.
purpose: Keeps the look of the whole app in one place.
why: Reason not stated in the code beyond the convenience of shared styling. Some comments say certain colors must not change.
how: Imports the map library's style sheet, defines color and font variables at the top, sets base rules for the page and links, and then adds rules for headers, buttons, forms, cards, and screen sizes.
inputs: None directly. It depends on the font variables and color variables defined in this file.
outputs: The appearance of the app on every page.
risks: Changing a shared color or font variable changes many screens at once. Only 7 of the 270 sections in this file are covered by these notes.
debug: If colors look wrong, check the color variables at the top. If fonts fall back to defaults, check that the font variables are supplied. If a page looks unstyled, check that this file is loaded.
